messages:
sam.support: Hey team — Customer ACCT-987 opened a ticket: model returned a user's email/phone in the completion. They pasted Request ID 01A2B3C4. Need repro steps + sanitized debug bundle for legal.
maria.engineer: Got it. Do we have the original prompt or just the returned text? Customer sent both in the ticket but asked us to scrub PII before we ingest.
alex.oncall: Can we ask them to run the minimal curl repro and share the response + X-Request-Id header? If they can't, we'll collect from logs.
sam.support: They can't share raw data. Asking for a redacted bundle. Suggested mapping: replace real emails/names/phones with deterministic pseudonyms AND include the mapping in an encrypted file.
luke.sre: For logs we can pull request-level traces. I need the timestamp window + Request ID. I have access to trace retention for that tenant. I'll grab traces for 2005001200-2005001300 unless they ask a different window.
eng-bot: Automated tip: run `redwood collect-debug --request 01A2B3C4 --scrub-mode pseudonymize --out debug.tgz` and upload to a secure share. See https://internal.redwood/debug-collect
maria.engineer: If the customer will share a curl, here's a safe template they can run locally (instruct them to replace secrets beforehand):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","input":"<REDACTED_PROMPT>"}' | jq '.'
```
maria.engineer: Ask them to remove any real names/emails in the prompt first. If they want, they can paste the prompt with tokens replaced: e.g., Alice -> <NAME_1>, alice@example.com -> <EMAIL_1>. Keep mapping in a separate file.
sam.support: Legal asks that mapping be delivered encrypted (password we will provide via phone). Also they want us to confirm we won't retain the mapping after triage.
triage: For our side, please include: 1) request headers (X-Request-Id), 2) 2-min surrounding service logs, 3) model, checkpoint id, generation params, 4) returned text, 5) sanitized prompt with mapping file.
luke.sre: I'll attach a minimal trace extract and add log snippet showing auth flow + latency metrics. We'll redact tokens and IPs on our side before sharing with customer if they require it.
alex.oncall: Quick checklist for the customer to scrub PII before upload:
- Replace names/emails/phones with placeholders (<NAME_n>, <EMAIL_n>, <PHONE_n>)
- Replace account IDs with ephemeral IDs (acct-987 -> ACC_R1)
- Remove any OAuth tokens/keys
- If they must include any real values for repro, put them in a separate encrypted mapping file and send passphrase out-of-band

maria.engineer: If they can't run the collect-debug tool, ask them to copy the curl output plus header line like `X-Request-Id: 01A2B3C4` and the raw response. We only need minimal bytes to repro.
sam.support: I'm going to reply to the customer with the curl template and the checklist + offer a secure upload link. Will request the encrypted mapping and confirm deletion policy.
eng-bot: Note: If we see model==gpt-lite-v2 and prompt length >4096, there is a known prefix leak risk — mention as possible root cause during triage.
triage: Flagging: also check billing spike around same time — sometimes retries cause duplicate token billing. Ask customer for their local retry policy and any client error logs.
sam.support: Thanks. I'll send the message now and ask them to get back with the sanitized bundle. Will update this thread when they upload. :white_check_mark:
